subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue be the broader no-new-config channel repair, the default-off graphMediaFallback config path, or a combined/narrowed version of both?
rationale: Both open PRs reference this issue, but one covers all channel root causes while changing fallback behavior without a new config knob, and the other adds operator-facing config while currently covering only the group-chat gate cleanly.

options.title: Prefer broader channel repair
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the canonical fix for this issue and treat the config-gated group-chat PR as separate or secondary.

options.title: Require config-gated behavior
options.body: Ask contributors to combine the team-GUID/reply-URL fixes with an explicit operator flag before the issue can close.

options.title: Split channel and group-chat fixes
options.body: Land one PR for the channel root causes and keep the group-chat graphMediaFallback decision scoped to a separate follow-up.

recommendation.title: Prefer broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the canonical fix for this issue and treat the config-gated group-chat PR as separate or secondary.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest sampled history across the Microsoft Teams plugin boundary and central media files, making him the best available routing candidate for the product/config tradeoff.
